newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Alltracel Pharmaceuticals to list on London's AIM.
newsitem.headline: Alltracel Pharmaceuticals to list on London's AIM.

text.p: Alltracel Pharmaceuticals, an Irish-owned pharmaceutical and medical devices company, said on Tuesday it expects to list on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on June 2 for a market capitalisation of 40 million stg.
The company was set up in October 1996 by Alltrade Financial Investment Ltd, a privately-owned Irish investment company.
Alltracel has a staff of 20 with sales and marketing offices across Europe and a production factory under construction in the Czech Republic.
Final production and processing are carried out in Ireland under sub-contract and Alltracel is negotiating to buy a pharmaceuticals company in Ireland.
The company said it could not list on the new Irish Developing Companies' Market (DCM) because it had only been operational for a few months.
Alltracel said it was about to appoint brokers for the listing.
